mentions.name: Bedtime Bulb v2
mentions.description: A light bulb that emits less blue light than other lighting, intended for bedtime use. It is relatively energy efficient, emits infrared, and dims smoothly with any dimmer; it is now shipping after years of development.
mentions.source_excerpt: Bedtime Bulb v2 [0], a light bulb that emits less blue light than other lighting, is finally shipping. It took years to get it right, but we figured out how to make a relatively energy efficient bulb that emits infrared and dims smoothly with any dimmer.
